name: Gov.sg (Singapore Government portal)

scam_info.sample: Learn how to verify trusted Singapore Government websites using .gov.sg domains, official short links (go.gov.sg, for.sg, for.edu.sg) and government-associated website listings.
scam_info.notes: Allowlist. 119 table rows; 134 distinct link hosts, 118 not ending in .gov.sg (town councils, hospitals, events, plus social hosts from the page chrome). Categories: Government Associated, Other Trusted Orgs, Official short links, Events. "Last updated on 6 November 2026". HTML only. A third-party mirror is elliotwutingfeng/GovSGTrustedSites allowlist.txt (per survey). Every gov page masthead links here (#govsites).

scam_info.sample: From 1 July 2024, all government SMS communications will be consolidated under a single, easily identifiable SMS sender ID - gov.sg .
scam_info.notes: Sender-ID allowlist rule. The exceptions list is on sms.gov.sg/exceptions.

scam_info.sample: Thu, 17 Oct 2024 | Tips to Spot Real and Digitally-Altered Content
scam_info.notes: Explainers RSS via rel=alternate: 70 items (2015 to 4 Nov 2026), only 2 scam/fake related. The sitemap (https://www.gov.sg/sitemap.xml) has only 160 URLs after the site rebuild; gov.sg "Factually" and older scam articles are not in it.

notes: Run by MDDI (Public Communications). The gov.sg brand is impersonated per the SPF brand tag "Gov.sg" (2 advisories; scam hosts on workers.dev and .online). The SMS sender ID "gov.sg" is protected: telcos block look-alike sender IDs (per sms.gov.sg).
